nodes.title: DENO · Quick Start
widgets_values:
## DENO · MiniMax H3 R2V

Generate video and synchronized audio from reference images.

### Quick start
1. Install the models and node packs linked below.
2. Add images in **Generate**. Their order maps to `<Picture 1>`, `<Picture 2>`, etc.
3. Write scene descriptions in English and dialogue in your chosen language.
4. Set the starting resolution in Resize Box and duration in seconds in Float.
5. Click Run. **Video Combine** writes an MP4 with audio below the latent stage.

### Starting settings
5 s · 24 fps / 896×512 → 1792×1024 / 8+2 steps

Stage 1 runs all 8 steps with the Alibaba turbo LoRA at the small size; its audio is kept. Stage 2 upscales the latent 2× in one pass and redraws only the last 2 steps with the DMD LoRA plus the Open-H3 refiner LoRA while the audio stays frozen.

The landscape default uses a **7:4** aspect ratio. Adjust resolution and duration to suit your hardware.

Reference images guide the content. Assign each image a role in the prompt; they do not fix the first frame.

### Memory and shared settings
Text Encoder Unload releases the connected text encoder after encoding, before either sampling stage.

Author: **DENO** · Workflow: **GPL-3.0-only**

[Homepage](https://denomcp.com) · [Workflow repository](https://github.com/Deno2026/deno-creator-skills)

Models and node packs retain their respective licenses and terms.

## PC-HOME adaptation (2026-10-30)
RTX4090 24GB; existing NVFP4 AWQ H3 encoder reused instead of downloading the 25GB INT8 encoder. Existing DMD LoRA and latent upscaler reused. All other model/steps/resolution settings follow the pinned author workflow. Add your own reference in Generate and write the prompt before Run. Start with a short clip; this preset does not guarantee long-duration stability. Existing ComfyUI/node code and launcher are unchanged.

Agent CLI operational policy: default requested5s; maximum requested10s (243frames/10.125s after alignment). Raw UI Float is not guarded by the CLI limit.15s refinement was stopped for resource pressure, not an OOM error. Listening/lip sync and exact identity remain unapproved. See AGENT_GUIDE.md.

**diffusion_models**

- DenoMix v3: [MiniMax-H3_DenoMix_ref2va_pruned_int8_v3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Deno2026/MiniMax-H3-DenoMix/resolve/main/MiniMax-H3_DenoMix_ref2va_pruned_int8_v3.safetensors) (19.53 GB)

- Stage 2 · DMD: [minimax_h3_dmd_ref2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora-ComfyUI/resolve/main/experimental/minimax_h3_dmd_ref2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors) (2.13 GB)
- Stage 2 · Open-H3 refiner (rank 16): [minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_refiner_rank_16_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_refiner_rank_16_bf16.safetensors) (147.9 MB)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors) (25.28 GB)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) (2.62 GB)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) (577.2 MB)

**latent_upscale_models**

- [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Konteni2/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/resolve/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors) (658.6 MB)

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── MiniMax-H3_DenoMix_ref2va_pruned_int8_v3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   ├── MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-Acc-8Step_pruned_comfy.safetensors
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_dmd_ref2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_refiner_rank_16_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   └── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
│       └── minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors
```

## Required Node Packs

- [DENO Custom Nodes](https://github.com/Deno2026/comfyui-deno-custom-nodes)
- [LBH H3 Latent Upscaler](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)
- [KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)

## Report Issue

Note: Requires ComfyUI with MiniMax H3 and Sol Attention support. Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare the models above.

- If memory runs out, lower the starting resolution or duration.
- For compiler errors, check the startup option `--disable-comfy-compiler`.
- Workflow issues: [Deno2026/deno-creator-skills](https://github.com/Deno2026/deno-creator-skills/issues)

nodes.title: Prompt · Speech Guidance
widgets_values:
## Writing the prompt

Use these six sections in English and assign a role to each reference:

`subject_definitions:` → `summary:` → `retention_analysis:` → `detailed_description:` → `overall_soundscape:` → `non_diegetic_music:`

Image order starts at `<Picture 1>`. Specify which face, clothing, style or background elements to use.

### With dialogue
Keep dialogue in its original language, e.g. `<d>[English]Hello.</d>`. Use speaker IDs only for characters who speak.

### Without dialogue
Describe the intended ambience and effects in `overall_soundscape`, e.g. `Only ambient sound and sound effects are heard.` Avoid describing talking or singing.

Listen to the saved audio. Unintended speech can still occur.
